en: Hand-colored vintage postcard showing a large, ornate neoclassical/Baroque-style building with a central dome, heavy sculptural reliefs over the upper façade, and a prominent central entrance. In front of the building there is a small square with a clock column, streetlamps, benches, trees, and early to mid‑20th‑century cars and pedestrians. A sidewalk café with red awnings occupies the ground floor facing the square.
